title: Set integrals of a function vanishing off B agree on sets that agree inside B
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, let μ be a measure on ℝ^{n+ℓ} (Amb n ℓ), φ : ℝ^{n+ℓ} → ℝ, and S, T, B ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} with B measurable, φ(w) = 0 for every w ∉ B, S ∩ B ⊆ T and T ⊆ S. Then ∫_S φ dμ = ∫_T φ dμ (Bochner set integrals; no integrability of φ and no measurability of S or T is assumed).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (φ : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (S T B : Set (Amb n ℓ)), MeasurableSet B → (∀ w, w ∉ B → φ w = 0) → S ∩ B ⊆ T → T ⊆ S → ∫ w in S, φ w ∂μ = ∫ w in T, φ w ∂μ
